summary: This bill, the "Degrees Not Debt Act of 2025," increases the maximum Federal Pell Grant award to $14,800 for the 2026-2027 and 2027-2028 award years, with subsequent years' awards adjusted based on the Consumer Price Index, effective July 1, 2026.

scores.thoughts: This bill is entirely focused on increasing the maximum Federal Pell Grant award, which directly translates to more financial aid for students to attend higher education institutions. This represents a significant increase in spending to support public (and private) education access.
